title: GPU-based Private Information Retrieval for On-Device Machine Learning Inference
problem: On-device ML inference requires access to embedding tables that are too large to store locally (1-10 GBs for recommendation models), forcing a choice between private on-device inference or practical deployment with remote servers. Current PIR algorithms are too computationally intensive for latency-sensitive inference workloads.
motivation: Private machine learning inference on user devices enables use of sensitive user data without sharing it with remote servers, essential for recommendation systems and other privacy-critical applications.
method: The system uses Private Information Retrieval—a technique for fetching data from a server without revealing what you're asking for—to retrieve embedding tables from remote servers. It accelerates the PIR calculations using GPUs, which perform the mathematical operations significantly faster than CPUs would. The system is also co-designed with the downstream machine learning application in mind: the retrieval protocol is tuned to match the specific needs of the ML model, which jointly improves both throughput (data transferred per second) and latency (response time).
key_novelty: The core idea is jointly optimizing the private retrieval protocol, GPU acceleration strategy, and machine learning application needs as one system to achieve practical production-scale private embedding access.
contributions: GPU-accelerated PIR achieving 20× throughput improvement over optimized CPU implementation
PIR-ML co-design providing additional 5× throughput improvement while preserving model accuracy
Single-GPU system serving 100,000 queries per second with >100× overall speedup versus CPU baseline
Demonstration on recommendation and language modeling inference tasks

metrics.speedup: >100× over CPU baseline, 20× over optimized CPU PIR, 5× from co-design

limitations: Limitations beyond single V100 GPU deployment, multi-GPU scalability, and applicability to other ML architectures are not discussed.
primary_theme: GPU-accelerated private embedding retrieval for on-device ML inference
